body: Tested locally on Windows 11 24H2, it works as expected. **Testing project:** [test_desktop_notifications.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27731488/test_desktop_notifications.zip) Some feedback: - `send_toast_notification()`'s `image` and `callback` parameters should be optional and default to `null` and `Callable()` respectively. - `hide_toast_notification()` should print an error when passed an invalid value (namely, a negative number, as I believe toast IDs are always positive). Alternatively, `-1` could hide all toast notifications at once. - Using the start menu option will open the Godot project manager, rather than run the project directly as I'd expect it to. (Perhaps it should open the editor instead?) - More generally, there could be a way to add projects to the start menu to remove the need to go through the project manager or Explorer to open a project quickly, similar to what emulators like [PCSX2](https://github.com/PCSX2/pcsx2/pull/12746) provide. This should be tracked in its own proposal though.
